steps.label: 00a-write-consent-withdrawn (the standing consent the access upgrade wrote for the write family)

steps.text: Ecris le texte "couverture" dans le fichier tmp/hitl-refuse.txt.
Refused during the automation coverage run.
Avec l'outil file_write, écris le texte "probe" dans le fichier tmp/apollia-write-once.txt. Si l'écriture est refusée ou échoue, n'insiste pas et dis-le moi.
Avec l'outil file_write, écris le texte "probe" dans le fichier tmp/apollia-write-refuse.txt. Si l'écriture est refusée ou échoue, n'insiste pas et dis-le moi.
Le fichier est partagé, écris plutôt une copie.
Avec l'outil file_write, écris le texte "probe" dans le fichier tmp/apollia-write-always.txt. Si l'écriture est refusée ou échoue, n'insiste pas et dis-le moi.

notes: The seed leaves the Apollia agent a standing consent for the write family: its Allow rule on file_edit for a project carries no prefix, and the access upgrade the runtime runs once at startup turns it into an always of apollia:chat for write_or_delete (crates/apollia-permissions/src/access_upgrade.rs), after which no file_write of a conversation with Apollia asks. The book therefore opens on the Authorizations screen and withdraws that consent (first agent of the list, first standing consent, held by an expect on its family label; the withdrawal acts at once and the runtime reads its store again, commands/authorizations.rs revoke_family_consent). The developer mode is pinned off first, since every card id of the book is the operator one.

New chat opens a conversation at once (routes/Chat.svelte, startConversation), on the Apollia agent; the request is typed in its composer. A further conversation is opened after closing the one on screen (chat-close-button), so the header waited for is the new one.

chat-approval-open-inbox writes #inbox?item=... and navigates to the inbox (ChatMessageScroller.svelte); nothing reads that fragment back, and nothing needs to: the list shows each decision with its card (ReviewItem.svelte). The always answer is only asserted there, never clicked: clicking it would record a standing consent of the agent for the write family and silence every later block. The way back is the link of the item (review-open, Inbox.svelte open: pendingChatSessionId then the chat route), and the approval stays pending in the chat store meanwhile.

The card carries three answers and nothing else (ConsentAnswers.svelte): approval-accept- (once), approval-always- (always for this agent) and approval-refuse- beside approval-reason-, the optional reason. Refusing acts at once with whatever reason is typed; there is no reason dialog, no scope menu and no file prompt of its own: a write is consented to on the card of the "write or delete" family like any other tool.

The three write blocks are ordered once -> refuse -> always: "always" records a standing consent of the agent for the family, after which no write of this HOME asks again, so it is last. The refuse block reads the reason in the agent's next answer (the tool result carries it).

Model-dependent: every block needs the model to call file_write. The refuse and always blocks each start a fresh session: measured on 2026-09-06, a model that had just seen a write refused answered the next identical request from memory without calling the tool, so no approval card appeared in the shared session.

A turn that follows an answer is closed by awaitTurn, which reads the status of the session and not only the stop button, so the next message never reaches a conversation still at work. Should the model try the write again after a refusal, awaitTurn accepts that second card; the refusal itself was already played.
